NORTHERN RIVER ELECTRIC COOPERATIVE
Schedule GS-2: General Service Tariff, Effective June 1, 2026

This schedule applies to commercial and industrial accounts with contract demand of 20 kW or greater. Rates below are exclusive of applicable state and local taxes.

Section 1: Customer Charge
Each account served under this schedule is billed a Customer Charge of $45.00 per month regardless of energy consumption. This charge recovers the fixed cost of metering and billing infrastructure.

Section 2: Energy Charges
Energy charges vary by season and by time of use. The Summer Season runs from June 1 through September 30. The Winter Season runs from October 1 through May 31.

During the Summer Season, On-Peak Energy is billed at 14.2 cents per kWh. On-Peak hours are defined as 2:00 PM to 8:00 PM on non-holiday weekdays. Summer Off-Peak Energy is billed at 6.8 cents per kWh for all hours outside the On-Peak window.

During the Winter Season, On-Peak Energy is billed at 11.5 cents per kWh. Winter Off-Peak Energy is billed at 5.9 cents per kWh.

Section 3: Demand Charges
Billed demand is the greater of the actual maximum 15-minute integrated demand in the billing period or 50 percent of the highest demand recorded in the preceding eleven months. The Summer Demand Charge is $16.75 per kW per month. The Winter Demand Charge is $11.40 per kW per month.

Section 4: Power Factor Adjustment
Accounts whose average power factor falls below 90 percent are subject to a Power Factor Penalty of 1.0 percent added to the total bill for each full percentage point by which the power factor is below 90 percent. No penalty applies to accounts maintaining a power factor of 90 percent or greater.

Section 5: Net Metering
Customers with qualifying distributed generation facilities of 25 kW or less may take service under the Net Metering Rider. Net-metered exports are credited at a Net Metering Credit Rate of 4.5 cents per kWh, applied monthly against the customer's energy charges. Any unused credit balance carries forward to the following billing period and does not expire.

Section 6: Minimum Bill
Each account is subject to a Minimum Monthly Bill of $150.00, inclusive of the Customer Charge. If calculated charges fall below this amount, the customer is billed the minimum.

Section 7: Late Payment Charge
Bills not paid within 21 days of the billing date are assessed a Late Payment Charge of 1.5 percent of the unpaid balance.

Section 8: Contract Demand
The minimum Contract Demand under this schedule is 20 kW. Accounts with contract demand between 20 kW and 500 kW are billed under Schedule GS-2. Accounts exceeding 500 kW of contract demand must be served under Schedule GS-3 (Large Power).
